notes: OpenCode joins the surfaces. Turn it on in Where Kit Lives and your Kit is right there inside OpenCode sessions, waking with the same memory it carries everywhere else.
OpenCode sessions become memories too. Data Sources now imports your OpenCode history, and new sessions keep flowing in as you work, so nothing said there is lost.
Steadier provider health alerts. One watcher holds the pager now, a single slow probe no longer cries wolf, and every all-clear names the alarm it is closing.
